title: DEV_TASK_REPORT
description: Investigation result (Phase 1): the proposed plan plus the acceptance criteria the verification agent checks against.

target_sub_repo.description: Name of the sub-repo the change lands in.

proposed_diff.description: Unified diff of the proposed change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkable cases that prove the fix works (the verification agent's case list). Each as 'action -> expected result'. Cover happy path + negative/gated + edge/empty.

rollback_plan.description: One line: how to revert if this breaks.
